images.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: square EcommerceWale Shredded Paper catalogue presentation.
Image 1: actual Ecosoft PRODUCT REFERENCE and edit target. Its royal blue paper is the only product identity reference.
Image 2: PRESENTATION STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: ceramic bowl, warm off-white studio background, camera angle, mound framing and soft lighting. Do NOT copy its light-blue paper colour or substitute its product.
Primary request: re-present ONLY the paper from Image 1 in the same low ivory speckled ceramic bowl format as Image 2, a centred mound with a few same-paper strands on the tabletop. Remove cardboard boxes, mug, jar, promotional graphics, circular inset and all other props from Image 1. The bowl is a styling prop, not sold.
Preserve exact royal blue hue from Image 1, matte paper texture, thickness, narrow strip width and characteristic lengths. CRITICAL: preserve the tiny regular accordion/zigzag crimps visible on Image 1; do not make straight strips, ribbon curls, tinsel or confetti.
Match Image 2 framing, bowl proportions and pale warm background. Full bowl visible, margins, photorealistic texture. No lettering, labels, logos, claims, weight markings or additional products. This changes the arrangement/styling only, not the paper product. Colour/material/cut accuracy beats prettiness.
images.review: Visually reviewed for source colour family and cut style; white is straight-cut, blue/orange crinkle-cut. Styling arrangement changed with owner approval, not pixel-identical or physically SKU-verified.
